backend/main.mo: Main backend actor managing access control, user profiles, balances, onboarding, and order storage with admin-restricted wallet operations.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old orders to include an owner field and producing a new actor state preserving balances and profiles.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to frontend files, components, and test IDs with high-confidence metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of numerous frontend files describing their purpose and behavior.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind base and dark theme variables using OKLCH color values along with base element styling.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point with root container and script loading the main React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up the React Router route tree and renders the router provider for all main application pages.
frontend/src/components/AppFooter.tsx: Footer with referral link sharing, copy-to-clipboard support, and credits link.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Header showing logo and authentication‑aware navigation with dynamic layout offset updates.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Root layout applying background, balance indicator, onboarding flow trigger, and toast handling.
frontend/src/components/BalanceIndicator: Displays user and admin wallet balances with loading states, zero-balance help, and sign‑in prompts based on authentication and admin status.
frontend/src/components/OrderConfirmatio: Shows order confirmation details including package info, price, video URL, and links to order status or creating another order.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s identity and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUrl.ts: Returns the current browser URL once on mount.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth state, login/logout logic, and persistent identity loading via a React context provider.
frontend/src/hooks/useOrders.ts: Handles creating orders and fetching orders by ID using the backend actor and react-query.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exposes queries and mutations for user profile, wallet balances, admin checks, and fund distribution using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for theming plus utility classes for safe-area positioned UI elements.
frontend/src/lib/backendError.ts: Maps backend error messages to cleaner, user-friendly text.
frontend/src/lib/copyToClipboard.ts: Provides a function to copy text to the clipboard using the Clipboard API with a textarea fallback.
frontend/src/lib/format.ts: Contains helpers to format timestamps, order IDs, PKR amounts, and bigint balances for display.
frontend/src/lib/packages.ts: Defines the Package interface and exports a list of preset TikTok booster packages.
frontend/src/lib/validation.ts: Validates URLs, ensuring they are non-empty and use http/https.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard showing wallet balance and system info with loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/CreditsPage.tsx: Credits page displaying project info, features, and contact links.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Dashboard for placing mock orders, managing balance, copying invite links, and distributing funds.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page for selecting packages, validating TikTok URLs, and creating orders with confirmation flow.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: React page for viewing and editing the authenticated user's profile, including picture upload, form validation, and saving via mutation hooks.
frontend/src/pages/SignUpPage.tsx: Sign‑up flow using Internet Identity, redirecting authenticated users to profile setup and handling login states and errors.
frontend/src/pages/StatusPage.tsx: Displays the status of an order by ID with loading, error, and success states, using fetched order data and formatted details.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters and session-stored parameters across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending colors, fonts, animations, and enabling typography, container queries, and animation plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing wallet system requirements, architectural notes, and known issues for the Node/React/Motoko stack.
